tasks.title: Stock data evidence hardening
tasks.why: Research data lacked reproducible instrument identity, corporate-action coverage, and point-in-time disclosure availability.
tasks.resolution: Added deterministic evidence artifact loaders, effective-interval validation, conservative date-only disclosure availability, and curation CLI evidence gates.
tasks.impact: Research and production curation now fail closed without required evidence; current provisional datasets remain unchanged until authoritative KRX/DART/corporate-action artifacts are supplied.

tasks.title: Stock data quality hardening for research and backtest
tasks.why: Full source profiling exposed unclassified instruments, invalid OHLC rows, unexplained price discontinuities, missing disclosure availability, and historical coverage gaps that could invalidate strategy research.
tasks.resolution: Added effective-dated instrument classification, structural bar quarantine, KRX calendar and feature-availability gates, corporate-action interval validation, deterministic quality reports and lineage hashes, and backtest provenance checks.
tasks.impact: Provisional migrations remain auditable and non-promotable; research/production datasets now require explicit evidence before eligible rows can feed training, replay, paper, or live paths.

tasks.title: Canonical stock data curation and backtest readiness
tasks.why: Legacy feature partitions were not directly consumable by the modern point-in-time research and replay contracts, and filesystem paths needed to be independent of .env.
tasks.resolution: Added deterministic legacy-to-v2 curation with target separation, PIT timestamps, quality quarantine, manifest/content hashes, Hive-partitioned Parquet storage, tamper validation, repository-local data paths, and curate/train/simulate wiring.
tasks.impact: The existing data/processed/features source remains immutable and provisional; canonical data/curated/stocks is the required input for reproducible training and backtesting, while promotion/live remains fail-closed until lineage evidence is supplied.

tasks.title: Deterministic Korean equity trading cycle
tasks.why: The stock bounded context lacked a single point-in-time planner that connected certified data, promoted artifacts, constrained sizing, target-position intents, and parity backtesting.
tasks.resolution: Added a pure trading-cycle planner, certified dataset and promotion gates, content-based cycle fingerprints, deterministic return-volatility sizing with sector/ADTV/gross constraints and DE_RISK handling, target-position execution semantics, and event-driven replay parity.
tasks.impact: Paper/live paths remain fail-closed behind promotion and readiness evidence; backtests and paper planning share the same planner; task and code ownership are indexed for maintenance.

tasks.title: Quarantine invalid stock OHLC rows
tasks.why: Two legacy stock rows contain zero open/high/low values during documented trading-halt or partial-session events, so price backfill would fabricate tradable data.
tasks.resolution: The provisional legacy adapter now retains every row with deterministic data_quality_status and data_quality_reason fields; non-positive or missing OHLC rows are quarantined and research_eligible_frame excludes them from training and scoring.
tasks.impact: Source evidence remains auditable, invalid sessions cannot contaminate features, labels, or simulation, and future licensed backfills can replace quarantined rows with provenance.

tasks.title: Point-in-time Korean equity strategy research and compounding ledger
tasks.why: The stock research path mixed legacy feature provenance with incomplete temporal validation, one-shot simulation, and ambiguous promotion evidence.
tasks.resolution: Added deterministic provisional legacy-panel certification, point-in-time feature and label contracts, stable Rank-IC composite derivation, purged walk-forward promotion, constrained target weights, effective-dated costs, settlement-aware multi-session ledger, rebalance exits, and independent stress evaluation.
tasks.impact: Strategy results are reproducible and fail closed to NO_TRADE when out-of-sample evidence, cost stress, capacity, or ledger invariants do not pass; KIS live integration remains a later boundary.

tasks.title: Consolidate legacy/modern package duplication
tasks.why: The refactored tree still exposed duplicate etf/etfs roots and retained historical file layouts, reducing AI navigation efficiency and obscuring ownership.
tasks.resolution: Consolidated shared contracts under core/storage, organized stocks and ETFs by research/trading/backtesting/workflows, rebuilt execution around intents/orders/readiness, and quarantined historical implementations under src/legacy with parity coverage.
tasks.impact: Stock and ETF boundaries are explicit, legacy code is isolated, new ML/research components are replaceable, and the architecture remains extensible without reintroducing duplicate roots.

tasks.title: Separate stock and ETF architecture with replaceable ML
tasks.why: Historical stock YetiRank, ETF strategy, data processing, simulation, and unfinished execution paths were coupled and lacked explicit asset boundaries.
tasks.resolution: Introduced explicit core asset contracts, isolated stocks and etfs packages, point-in-time ML dataset/split/artifact boundaries, ETF parity fixtures, and paper-only execution gates; aligned filters tests and quality tooling with the migration boundary.
tasks.impact: Research and simulation paths are structurally separated; legacy modules remain excluded/read-only during migration, and live order submission remains gated.
